decision.buyer: Battery-management and cell engineers choosing charge protocols (a hypothesis; no customer demand is claimed).
decision.engineering_decision: Choose a two-stage constant-current fast-charge protocol, predicting voltage, temperature, lithium-plating margin and capacity fade before committing to it.
decision.intended_use: Predict the specified PyBaMM DFN (OKane2022) cell's response to a charge protocol over the declared input box; agreement is with that model, not with real cells.

design_variables.name: c1

design_variables.description: Ambient temperature, bounds 5 to 40 (an operating condition, not a design choice).
design_variables.name: t_amb_c

design_variables.description: Initial state of charge, bounds 0.05 to 0.5 (an operating condition).
design_variables.name: soc0

limits.basis: OD-2 provisional DEVELOPMENT rule: 2 x the largest seed-to-seed SD from three seeds (RESULT section 5). Not a scientific value.

next_experiment: The M4 two-host GPU run and the adaptive-agent campaign (owner-approved 2026-09-26, USD 14 and USD 6 ceilings), then EV2 with a decision-aware robustness component.

population.proposed: Development sampling of (c1, c2, t_amb_c, soc0) over INPUT_BOUNDS through carbon.seeding, under the OD-2 provisional DEVELOPMENT settings. Not a ratified production population.

recommendation.basis: 2,604 main-run references all OK (recounted), all 7 frozen verification criteria passed on 200 private cases, and the fresh finalist comparison stopped every memorizing candidate (RESULT sections 1 to 4).

reference.applicability: The declared input box only; 30 cycles; the specified model, not real cells (RESULT section 11 item 7). Solver licence and redistribution review are not recorded here.
reference.model: DFN with OKane2022 parameters, SEI and partially reversible plating, lumped thermal
reference.solver: PyBaMM 26.8.0.0 (hash-locked overlay on the digest-pinned study image)
